meme_name: Pawri / Ye Hamari Pawri Ho Rahi Hai
text: Pawri , also known as Ye Hamari Pawri Ho Rahi Hai is a catchphrase and reaction image meme featuring a girl saying "This is our party" in a mocking American accent. The video was first uploaded to Instagram by Pakistani creator Dananeer before clips with the phrase gained virality on Indian and Pakistani internet communities.

meme_name: Pawri / Ye Hamari Pawri Ho Rahi Hai
text: On February 6th, 2021, Instagram [1] user @Dananeerr posted a video of her and her friends vacationing in a mountainous region, along with a caption that read, "No one: / When borgors visit northern areas: yeh hamari pawri horai haai," which translates to "we are having our party." The word borgors is a deprecatory slang term used to describe westernized Pakistanis, akin to the use of the word "Oreo" in the US. The video went viral and has gathered over 9 million views in over 2 years(seen below).

meme_name: Pawri / Ye Hamari Pawri Ho Rahi Hai
text: On February 12th, 2021, Instagram [2] musician @ashrajmukhate posted a remix of the aforementioned clip, gathering over 9 million views in over 2 years as well (seen below).
